description: ShrunkTransfer from Replogle K562 genome-wide pseudobulk; alpha=0.1974 and prior_sd=4 selected by nested cross-validation on held-out targets in an external K562->RPE1 development experiment. Applied to each official context's own basal control profile, with a compositional correction so unsupported genes realise exactly zero change. No perturbed data from contexts A/B/C was used. Packaged with a streaming validator/packager at parity with vcc prep 0.2.0.
